title: 武外乒乓球校队参加三校联赛
excerpt:
校队成员祁子傲、任峻贤、付大卫代表外高，参加了英中、外高、省实验的三校联赛
最终以2:3不敌省实验队，3:0战胜英中队，获得亚军

title_en: WFLS Table Tennis School Team at the Three-School League
excerpt_en:
School team members QI Ziao, REN Junxian and FU Dawei represented WFLS in the three-school league between Yingzhong, WFLS and the Provincial Experimental School
They lost 2:3 to the Provincial Experimental team and beat the Yingzhong team 3:0, finishing as runners-up
